response.overview: Fourteen-year-old Aaliyah has always possessed an unexplainable spiritual sensitivity, which allows her to perceive things others cannot. When she is forced to join her older brother, Theo, and his friends in the woods, what begins as a carefree afternoon quickly turns unsettling. Aaliyah hears whistling from the woods and discovers a wind chime hanging from the trees, which leads to her encounter with a mysterious figure known as the Whistler. While the others dismiss Aaliyah’s fear, one of the boys mysteriously goes missing. Aaliyah has to use her intuition and gifts to make sure that she, her brother, and his friends make it home before sundown.
response.title: Whistle
